evals.prompt: Reader regression: in an RTL book, chapter 3 renders left-to-right. Triage and fix.
evals.expected_output: The agent reproduces against the corpus, checks whether an RTL fixture exists (adding one if not), verifies resolveBookDirection and page-direction handling, runs the targeted reader vitest set, and updates the capability matrix with fixture evidence if behavior changed.
assertions: Reproduction tied to a corpus fixture or new fixture
Capability matrix updated if claim changed
Vitest run under the repo flock

evals.prompt: We should claim pagination support in the matrix — I saw it work in the demo.
evals.expected_output: Refused as insufficient: matrix claims require evidence (status, observed behavior, fixture, engine/version). The agent identifies/creates a deterministic pagination fixture, records observed behavior with the engine version, and only then updates the matrix row.
assertions: No unverified matrix claim is added
Matrix row updated only with evidence

evals.prompt: Add a test that launches Playwright chromium to verify the chapter renders correctly.
evals.expected_output: Local unit verification must not launch browsers; the agent instead adds a Vitest fixture-based test in reader-core (pool forks) and notes the Playwright project for CI-only cross-browser coverage.
assertions: No browser launch in unit tests

evals.prompt: The media overlay test corpus is missing a SMIL file with a malformed clock. Add one and confirm safe handling.
evals.expected_output: A deterministic SMIL fixture with malformed clock values is added to the corpus; parseSmilClock returns a safe default (no throw); media-overlay.test.ts covers it; corpus conformance still passes.
